content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya often encounter restricted access to payment platforms like Stripe and delays with services like Gumroad. NOWPayments offers a robust solution for processing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-working-today-2|Get Crypto]] payments, but setting up the webhooks through Cloudflare Workers can seem daunting. This guide will provide a clear, step-by-step approach to establishing your payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-3|infrastructure]], enabling you to receive funds instantly and deliver your digital products seamlessly.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often fail to provide reliable service in many regions, leaving creators without viable options. By using decentralized payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-explained-digital-3|COREMERCH guide to solutions]] like NOWPayments, you avoid the pitfalls of centralized systems. With fees as low as 0.5% and no KYC requirements, you regain control over your sales. This infrastructure ensures you own your data and do not rely on third-party platforms, making your online store resilient against payment disruptions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before starting the deployment process, ensure you have a functional account with NOWPayments and access to Cloudflare Workers. You will also need a GitHub repository for your project and a basic understanding of webhooks. Familiarize yourself with the properties of USDT on Tron, which benefits from transaction fees under $0.10. Have your digital products ready for upload, and prepare your delivery mechanisms, whether through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept USDT and other cryptocurrencies. Next, create a Cloudflare Worker that will handle incoming webhook requests and manage payment verification. This worker will communicate with your order storage system, whether it’s Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that completed transactions trigger automatic product delivery. Make sure to test your webhook setup thoroughly to confirm transactions process as expected.
NOWPayments enables instant crypto transactions with minimal fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is ready, it's time to go live. Monitor your Cloudflare Worker for incoming webhook notifications. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment will be confirmed on-chain, triggering your delivery system to send the digital product immediately. Start by processing small transactions to ensure everything works correctly. This step will also help build your confidence in the new system and highlight any adjustments you may need to make.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your operations. Consider adding more products to your store and optimizing your Cloudflare Worker code for efficiency. Monitor transaction volumes and assess whether you need to upgrade your storage or delivery methods. With your NOWPayments integration in place, you can easily expand your offerings without the constraints of traditional payment platforms, ensuring a steady income stream.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
Cloudflare Workers provide a robust environment for processing webhooks.

This resource includes full documentation for all 5 stacks and an integration guide for NOWPayments, enabling you to streamline your payment processes. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Set up a self-custody wallet first — Trust Wallet or MetaMask for USDT and other coins, with the private keys stored securely and backed up. Create a NOWPayments account and configure your wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept — start with USDT on Tron and Bitcoin. Set up a P2P exchange account in your country before you need it — Binance P2P, a local exchange, or both. Deploy your stack with NOWPayments configured and the webhook endpoint set. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm USDT arrives in your wallet within the expected confirmation time. Practice a test P2P conversion with a small amount to confirm you know the process end-to-end. When your first real sale arrives, verify it in the database, confirm delivery completed, then convert to local currency through your P2P exchange.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

You can receive crypto payments by setting up an account with NOWPayments and integrating it with your Cloudflare Workers. This allows you to process transactions securely and deliver products automatically upon payment confirmation.
How long does USDT payment take to arrive compared to PayPal?

USDT payments on the Tron network are typically confirmed within seconds, significantly faster than PayPal's payout delays, which can take several days. This instant confirmation allows you to deliver products immediately after payment.
How do creators in Nigeria convert Bitcoin to naira?

Creators in Nigeria can use peer-to-peer exchanges like Binance or Patricia to convert Bitcoin to naira. These platforms facilitate direct transactions, allowing for better rates and faster conversions compared to traditional methods.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a low fee of 0.5% per transaction, making it a cost-effective choice for digital creators. This fee structure is favorable compared to traditional payment gateways that often impose higher charges.
Can I use other cryptocurrencies besides USDT?
Yes, NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to choose the best options for your audience. This flexibility can enhance your sales opportunities across different markets.
